Subject: Scheduling dedicated capacity-sizing call — FintechCo

Hi Sam,

Thanks for taking the time earlier today — great to learn about FintechCo's plan to embed real-time LLM explanations into your fraud pipeline. Quick recap from our call:

- Primary flow: synchronous explainability API called on each transaction
- Target latency: p95 < 200ms
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~800 reqs/sec
- Peak concurrency: ~300 concurrent requests
- Average tokens per request: ~150 (including prompt + expected completions)

Next steps: we'd like to schedule a 60-minute dedicated capacity-sizing call with our solutions and infra team to go through traffic patterns, token distributions, and preliminary sizing. That will let us recommend Dedicated capacity (GPU type, instance counts, batching) and provide a rough cost estimate.

Can you confirm who should join from your side (engineering, infra)? Below are a couple proposed slots (PT):

- Tue 2027-06-15 10:00—11:00
- Wed 2027-06-16 09:00—10:00
- Wed 2027-06-16 13:00—14:00

I attached our capacity-sizing worksheet — filling the traffic/sample fields ahead of the call helps speed things up.

Attachment: capacity-sizing-template.xlsx

Calendly: https://cal.com/redwood/sizing-call-60
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Hi Sam/Jesse — looking forward to the call. Confirmed: Wed 2027-06-16 09:00—10:00 PT (I've blocked the slot). I'll run the session.

Pre-call asks (if you can share before the meeting, it will make the sizing much faster):
- 48h traffic trace (timestamps + requests/sec) or 1-minute granularity time series
- Token distribution sample (prompt vs response tokens, 100—500 samples)
- Typical request/response sequence length and any long-tail outliers
- Which model variant you expect to use (open model name or size) and whether you plan to use quantized weights
- Any prefix caching you expect (e.g., same customer/context repeated)

Proposed agenda (60 min):
1) 15m: platform & integration overview
2) 30m: workload deep dive (traffic patterns, token distributions)
3) 15m: initial sizing and next steps (recommended GPU families, estimated instance counts, follow-up evals)

I've attached the capacity sizing worksheet again. If you can drop the trace + samples to the shared Drive link before Tue EOD, I'll pre-run a short simulation and bring preliminary numbers to the call.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/fintechco/sizing-sheet
